welcome.title: Welcome to Next Episode
welcome.body: Track your shows and movies, see what's coming next and compete in the quiz with friends. Takes 30 seconds.

add.title: Build your list
add.body: In the Search tab, tap + to follow a show or save a movie to To watch.

track.title: Mark what you've watched
track.body: Tap the episode's ✓, or swipe a Watchlist card to the left. The next episode takes its place.

remind.title: Never miss a release
remind.body: In Upcoming, tap Notify me and we'll remind you on the day the movie comes out.

quiz.title: Daily quiz
quiz.body: A new question every day at 8 PM. Get them right in a row to keep your streak 🔥

friends.title: Watch together
friends.body: Add friends to see what they're watching in the Feed and climb the quiz leaderboard.
